text:
tess: Quick thread to scope a Console feature set: customer wants a SLO-correlated cost view (route + model variant) + low-overhead trace hooks so finance and SRE can run joint postmortems. I sketched a proposal below for MVP, canary, and launch gates.

omar: Good problem to solve. Want the cost math to be transparent in-product (formula + confidence band). Finance hates black boxes.

lucy: Storage caveat: raw traces are big. We should introduce a "trace lane" concept: tiny excerpt lane (keeps a few spans + metadata) persisted longer, and full-trace lane sampled and short-lived. Default: excerpt 30d, full-sampled 7d.

praveen: Implementation sketch: compute a cheap per-request cost estimate synchronously (tokens + model GPU-multiplier) and attach a tiny envelope to a WAL. Apply pre-sampling by route before any heavy serialize. Envelope fields minimal: tenant_id, route, model_id, token_count, duration_est_ms, error_flag, trace_excerpt_ptr. Async indexer will build aggregates.

joan: Product constraints: 1) RBAC (billing vs eng vs oncall) on cost and trace links; 2) exportable "finance artifact" (CSV + JSON) with a confidence indicator; 3) PII redaction hooks + KMS tagging for Private installs. All three are GA blockers for regulated customers.

tess: MVP surface (minimal):
- Route-level token + cost meter (top-10 routes)
- Model-variant multiplier visible and editable by tenants
- SLO-correlated cost heatmap (route vs time) with overlay of p95 latency and error-rate
- Trace lanes: excerpt lane default 30d, sampled full-trace lane short-lived
- Finance export (CSV) including sampling_rate and confidence (low/med/high)
- RBAC + redaction toggle for Private

omar: Canary idea: tenant opt-in canary (feature flag) on 10 tenants: run 72h with synthetic and production traffic. Metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency delta, error-rate delta, dataplane CPU delta, and telemetry storage delta. Thresholds proposal: p95 delta <5%, error uplift <0.2pp, CPU delta <10%, telemetry spend delta <15% (pause if >18%).

lucy: Sampling defaults proposal: excerpt_lane: 0.05% global + route overrides; full_trace_lane: 0.005% + always sample on error/anomaly. Must show sampling_meter in UI so customers see what they paid for.

praveen: Perf guardrails: do pre-sampling, keep envelope <256 bytes typical, batch uploads per-tenant to object store, and have a tunable backpressure path that disables sampling under overload. Also prefer protobuf envelope to minimize CPU.

joan: Acceptance / launch gates (draft):
- Functional: route cost + model multiplier visible; SLO-correlated heatmap + trace excerpts available for incidents
- Reliability: instrumentation adds <10% CPU on dataplane in stress tests
- Quality: canary shows no p95 latency regressions >5% or error-rate uplift >0.2pp
- Economics: telemetry storage delta target <+12% infra spend first quarter; hard guardrail +25% requires exec approval
- Security: redaction hooks + KMS tagging enabled for Private customers
- UX: one dashboard template, sampling meter, and finance-export button + short migration doc

tess: Operational flow idea: on a cost spike the Console surfaces an "incident artifact" with route list, cost delta estimate, tokens delta, confidence, sampled excerpt links, and an export button. One click generates a finance artifact and attaches to postmortem.

omar: Add synthetic-driven preflight: before each canary run, run a small synthetic workload to validate instrumentation correctness (token counts, model multiplier) and to prime the sampling reservoirs.

lucy: Retention knobs we should expose: excerpt_retention_days, full_trace_retention_days, aggregate_retention_days, and a per-tenant storage cap with chosen behavior (throttle vs oldest-drop).

praveen: Dev tasks I foresee: envelope schema + proto impl, pre-sample integration in runtime, WAL writer + async indexer, batch uploader, dashboard queries, export generator, and backpressure path. We need QPS/size estimates to simulate.

joan: Prioritization: this is a top-10 enterprise ask; recommend P0 for next quarter and attach customer vignette to the PRD. If not P0 we risk losing the deal.

observability-bot: created issue #5333: "console: SLO-correlated route-cost + trace-lanes MVP" and assigned to @tess @praveen @lucy. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/5333

tess: Next steps / owners:
- Praveen: proto envelope & perf sim + perf target verification (due Wed)
- Lucy: sampling UX + retention knobs UI mock (due Thu)
- Omar: canary orchestration + synthetic preflight (due Fri)
- Joan: RBAC + export + redaction checklist + customer vignette (due 5 days)
I'll schedule a 30m sync after initial artifacts land. Thanks all :rocket:
